# Inspection (`inspect`)

Area `inspect` is owned by WP6-INSPECT; its contracts live in `src/contracts/areas/inspect.ts`.

## `list_modules` — List Modules

List loaded modules with base, size, path, preferred ImageBase read from the file on disk, PE timestamp and optional file sha256 (hash: true), plus the module-map id and epoch that address results cite. Filter by name substring; paged with a total. Reads through the already-injected agent; frida-agent.dll is hidden. To rebase a Ghidra/REA address, pass module:0xVA to any address field.

| Phase | Hints                 | Effects                                       | Gate | CLI                             |
| ----- | --------------------- | --------------------------------------------- | ---- | ------------------------------- |
| P1    | read-only, idempotent | readsTargetMemory, mutatesSession, idempotent | —    | `bea modules` (session-oneshot) |

| Input field  | Type                                                                    | Required | Default | Description                                                         |
| ------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `session_id` | string `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$` | yes      | —       | Session id from spawn_process, attach_process or emu_open.          |
| `filter`     | string ≤256                                                             | no       | —       | Case-insensitive module-name substring.                             |
| `hash`       | boolean                                                                 | no       | `false` | sha256 of each listed module file (cached by path, size and mtime). |
| `offset`     | integer 0..100000000                                                    | no       | `0`     |                                                                     |
| `limit`      | integer 1..1000                                                         | no       | `100`   |                                                                     |

Deadline 30,000 ms · input ≤ 1,048,576 bytes · evidence always as `bea.modules.list` · sessions live, emulation · results carry untrusted target content.

## `list_memory_ranges` — List Memory Ranges

List memory ranges with base, size, protection and owning module (BEA attributes ranges itself; Windows reports no file names), filtered by minimum protection, module or kind (image or private), optionally coalesced; paged with total count and bytes. Use it to choose scan and dump scopes. Read-only through the injected agent.

| Phase | Hints                 | Effects                                       | Gate | CLI                          |
| ----- | --------------------- | --------------------------------------------- | ---- | ---------------------------- |
| P1    | read-only, idempotent | readsTargetMemory, mutatesSession, idempotent | —    | `bea maps` (session-oneshot) |

| Input field  | Type                                                                    | Required | Default | Description                                                |
| ------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
| `session_id` | string `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$` | yes      | —       | Session id from spawn_process, attach_process or emu_open. |
| `protection` | "---" \| "r--" \| "rw-" \| "r-x" \| "rwx"                               | no       | `"r--"` | Minimum protection (Frida semantics).                      |
| `module`     | string ≤260                                                             | no       | —       | Only ranges of this module.                                |
| `kind`       | "all" \| "image" \| "private"                                           | no       | `"all"` |                                                            |
| `coalesce`   | boolean                                                                 | no       | `true`  |                                                            |
| `offset`     | integer 0..100000000                                                    | no       | `0`     |                                                            |
| `limit`      | integer 1..1000                                                         | no       | `200`   |                                                            |

Deadline 30,000 ms · input ≤ 1,048,576 bytes · evidence always as `bea.memory.ranges` · sessions live · results carry untrusted target content.

## `list_threads` — List Threads

List the target's threads (tid, name the program set with SetThreadDescription or null, entry routine as module+RVA, main flag) and optionally their general registers. Thread state is unreliable on Windows and is not reported. Use the tids for call_function thread_id, trace_execution thread_ids and hook thread filters. Read-only through the injected agent.

| Phase | Hints                 | Effects                                       | Gate | CLI                             |
| ----- | --------------------- | --------------------------------------------- | ---- | ------------------------------- |
| P2    | read-only, idempotent | readsTargetMemory, mutatesSession, idempotent | —    | `bea threads` (session-oneshot) |

| Input field  | Type                                                                    | Required | Default | Description                                                |
| ------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
| `session_id` | string `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$` | yes      | —       | Session id from spawn_process, attach_process or emu_open. |
| `registers`  | boolean                                                                 | no       | `false` | Include general registers (rax..r15, rip).                 |
| `offset`     | integer 0..100000000                                                    | no       | `0`     |                                                            |
| `limit`      | integer 1..1000                                                         | no       | `100`   |                                                            |

Deadline 30,000 ms · input ≤ 1,048,576 bytes · evidence always as `bea.threads.list` · sessions live · results carry untrusted target content.

## `read_memory` — Read Memory

Read up to 64 KiB of target or emulator memory at an address expression, optionally following a pointer chain first (deref offsets, Cheat-Engine [[a]+o1]+o2 semantics), returned as hex or base64 or as a typed array view (f32, i32, ptr, utf16 ...). An unreadable page ends the read: check complete and returned. Bytes are untrusted target content. Read-only.

| Phase | Hints                 | Effects                                       | Gate | CLI                                           |
| ----- | --------------------- | --------------------------------------------- | ---- | --------------------------------------------- |
| P1    | read-only, idempotent | readsTargetMemory, mutatesSession, idempotent | —    | `bea read <address> <size>` (session-oneshot) |

| Input field        | Type                                                                       | Required | Default | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| ------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `session_id`       | string `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$`    | yes      | —       | Session id from spawn_process, attach_process or emu_open.                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `address`          | string ≤600                                                                | yes      | —       | 0xVA \| module+0xRVA \| +0xRVA (main) \| module!export[+0xN] \| module!#ordinal \| module:0xSTATIC_VA[/0xSTATIC_BASE] \| $main:0xSTATIC_VA; quote names with + or spaces; module@0xBASE picks one of two same-named modules |
| `deref`            | array<integer -16777216..16777216> ≤8                                      | no       | —       | Pointer chain offsets: [[address]+d0]+d1… (Cheat Engine semantics).                                                                                                                                                         |
| `size`             | integer 1..65536                                                           | no       | `64`    |                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `view`             | "hex" \| "base64" \| "i8" \| "u8" \| "i16" \| "u16" \| "i32" \| "u32" \| … | no       | `"hex"` |                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `sensitive_values` | array<string ≤256> ≤64                                                     | no       | —       | Literals (≥ 4 bytes) whose matches are dropped from the result and evidence.                                                                                                                                                |

Deadline 30,000 ms · input ≤ 1,048,576 bytes · evidence always as `bea.memory.read` · sessions live, emulation · results carry untrusted target content.

## `disassemble` — Disassemble

Disassemble count instructions, or the whole .pdata function containing the address, from a live or emulation session. Shows original bytes where BEA hooks are installed, and resolves branch, call and RIP-relative targets to address forms (module+RVA, static VA). Read-only.

| Phase | Hints                 | Effects                                       | Gate | CLI                                      |
| ----- | --------------------- | --------------------------------------------- | ---- | ---------------------------------------- |
| P1    | read-only, idempotent | readsTargetMemory, mutatesSession, idempotent | —    | `bea disasm <address>` (session-oneshot) |

| Input field  | Type                                                                    | Required | Default | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| ------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `session_id` | string `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$` | yes      | —       | Session id from spawn_process, attach_process or emu_open.                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `address`    | string ≤600                                                             | yes      | —       | 0xVA \| module+0xRVA \| +0xRVA (main) \| module!export[+0xN] \| module!#ordinal \| module:0xSTATIC_VA[/0xSTATIC_BASE] \| $main:0xSTATIC_VA; quote names with + or spaces; module@0xBASE picks one of two same-named modules |
| `count`      | integer 1..512                                                          | no       | `32`    |                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `function`   | boolean                                                                 | no       | `false` | Disassemble the whole .pdata function containing address (≤ 4096 instructions).                                                                                                                                             |

Deadline 30,000 ms · input ≤ 1,048,576 bytes · evidence always as `bea.code.disassembly` · sessions live, emulation · results carry untrusted target content.
